paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Nezira, in R' Yitzhak's name: Shekalim, chapter 2. R' Simon reports in his name: Jerusalem Shabbat 2:3. In Bavli Shabbat 33b: ben Nezira. There is also a person named Nezira; see his entry. R' Levi ben Nezira: see his entry, for it is a scribal error.
